copy.headline: Houston muscles past Kansas to cap 3-day run, stamps claim to No. 1 ranking
copy.caption:
Houston made a clear statement it belongs atop the rankings, capping its run through the Players Era 8 win a 92-83 win over No. 11 Kansas on Thursday night. LAS VEGAS -- Despite winning a nation-leading 162 games over the past five seasons, Houston entered 2026-27 with its lowest preseason ranking since 2021.

It took the Cougars all of three weeks to make a clear statement they belong at the top. No. 8 Houston knocked off No. 11 Kansas 92-83 on Thursday night in the championship game of the Players Era 8 on Thursday night.

story.summary: Houston made a clear statement it belongs atop the rankings, capping its run through the Players Era 8 win a 92-83 win over No. 11 Kansas on Thursday night. LAS VEGAS -- Despite winning a nation-leading 162 games over the past five seasons, Houston entered 2026-27 with its lowest preseason ranking since 2021. It took the Cougars all of three weeks to make a clear statement they belong at the top. No. 8 Houston knocked off No. 11 Kansas 92-83 on Thursday night in the championship game of the Players Era 8 on Thursday night. The Cougars will leave Las Vegas with three victories, including Wednesday's win over No. 1 Florida . Combined with losses by the Nos. 1, 2 and 3 teams, Houston could rise to No. 1 when next week's AP poll is released Monday afternoon. Houston imposed its will in the first half, jumping to a 15-3 lead and forcing Kansas to use two timeouts in the first five minutes.…
